contexts.text: Like trees stripped of their leaves, on which hang dried apples left there from autumn.

(Solifidians say that an apple-bearing tree produces apples, but if a man does goods for the sake of salvation, as that tree produces apples by continuity, then those apples are decayed within, and full of worms.)
Seed of an orange, a citron, an apple, a pear...
The state of the Church before the Lord's Advent may be compared to the rind of any fruit; as of an orange, an apple, a pear, a grape... SE 3738.
That innovator, who has cast the apple of discord before the leading men of the Church.
Like serpents of the tree of knowledge... holding in their hands apples thence, painted with reddish yellow colours.
